answers_ref.headline: Riyadh's hotel pipeline is unusually deep right now — a live tracker counts 13 hotels under construction plus 1 newly announced, with architecture firm Aedas holding the most projects in the city.

proposed_rules.rule: Whenever compliance is claimed, name which layer it satisfies — product certification versus building-level design code or green rating — rather than saying "certified".
proposed_rules.detail: SEEC and Ministry of Energy sources confirm lighting energy requirements now sit inside SBC 601/602 at design stage, governed separately from SASO product certificates, and Mostadam gates at project level via REGA. A project can pass one and fail the other, so undifferentiated "certified" language is both weaker and riskier than precision. Evidence: two primary government sources plus one vendor compliance page — strong on the existence of the layers, moderate on how hard the tender gates bite. This distinction outlives the December 2026 deadline.

proposed_rules.rule: When addressing MEP contractors and engineering firms, lead with delivery certainty — lead time, stock position, procurement chain — before design credentials.
proposed_rules.detail: An MEP-contracting industry source names late procurement of specialist equipment as one of the most common causes of programme delay on Saudi projects, advising procurement to start at contract award. That makes "will it arrive on time" the contractor's first question and our 20+ certified-partner network an answer to it, not just a curation claim. Evidence is one industry source rather than a survey — moderate — but the fear structure is consistent with the Vision 2030 pipeline and is unlikely to change within a year.

market_direction.movement: Huda Lighting is the only competitor on the board actually publishing — four posts a week, half of them reels, in a deliberately casual retail voice ("POV: you came in for one thing and now you're looking at everything") that reads as footfall marketing for its new Riyadh showroom rather than specifier content.

market_direction.so_what: Documentation and delivery certainty are becoming the specifier's real questions, and they are questions a 45-year certified-partner integrator can answer better than a single-brand importer.
market_direction.movement: The web evidence points the same way from three separate lenses: buyers are shifting their evaluation criteria from how a fixture looks to whether it clears certification and arrives on time — SASO non-certification now means automatic tender disqualification, SBC 601/602 and Mostadam gate at project level, and MEP contractors name late equipment procurement as the top cause of programme slippage.
